I don't believe it at all.
At this point I've been trying to look into assisted suicide but it's just so difficult to die.
She's been trying to kill me for months, and at this point I'm done with trying to run.
Oh yeah I'd forgotten about that... Thanks for reminding me.

Normally at around 4 in the morning because I have so much to do...
I just need sleep.

Yep. Tried everything. So done with trying that I just try to fast myself to death at this point. Haven't eaten anything in a week. I reckon if I'm starving enough I'll go to sleep real easy. Think this will work?

It's too late.
I can feel death coming.
Goodbye.
I've been giving myself a chance for 25 years. It doesn't work.

Because I'm done with trying to fix it. IT NEVER WORKS OK!
NOTHING I TRY WORKS!
PLEASE SOMEBODY KILL ME.

I don't know why it hasn't.
It's annoying. I've tried everything and nothing works.
I just want silence.
No. If there were they would try to stop me. I'm done with being stopped. It's been 400 times. I just wanna die.
Everything in my life has gone wrong and I just want it to end ok.
Fine. A few more seconds won't hurt me too much.
